<thought>We need to find the retrosynthetic template that, when applied to the protected alcohol molecule (containing an O‑Si bond), breaks the O‑Si bond to give the original alcohol and a silylating reagent. The forward reaction breaks an aliphatic hydroxyl group (O‑H) and forms an O‑Si bond. Using the catalog search with the broken functional group “aliphatic hydroxyls” should retrieve the appropriate template and its ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": null,
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
